name: Ralenti et images par seconde (RIFE)
description: Creates a new media file from the selected clip with images invented by the RIFE v4 network (optional model rife-v4, 12 MB, MIT): a clean slow motion (x2, x4, x8) or a new frame rate (24 to 60 i/s). The original is not touched; the result (ProRes 422 LT) is imported into the project. Slow motion drops the audio. Variables: --var fps=60, --var slow=4, --var preset=prores_hq|h264.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Ralenti x2
entries.description: Twice as slow, same frame rate, in-between frames computed by RIFE.

entries.label: Ralenti x4
entries.description: Four times as slow, same frame rate.

entries.label: Passer à 60 i/s
entries.description: Same speed, 60 images per second (--var fps=50 for another rate).
